decision_titles: Reserve signs on seats for flag bearers
plain_text:
VETERAN’S MEMORIAL COMMITTEE 
 
Meeting of the Veterans Memorial Committee was held on October 19, 2026 at Wallingford Town Hall 
Room 220. Chairman Ruth Palmer called the meeting to order at 1900. There were 8 members present.  
 
Minutes for previous meeting approved as submitted. 
 
This meeting is to continue planning Veterans Day service. 
 
Discussion held regarding program; will put reserve signs on seats for flag bearers. 
 
George Messier has Gold Star banners; discussion as to how to distribute. 
 
Next meeting is November 2, 2026 at 1900 at Wallingford Town Hall Room 220.  
 
Meeting adjourned at 1932 after a moment of silence for departed members. 
 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
 
Elise M. Gallup 
Secretary
